description: Urban Waste Water Treatment Regulations (UWWTR) Sensitive Area - Shellfish Waters is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Natural Resources Wales. The Water Environment (Water Framework Directive) (England and Wales) Regulations 2017 (WFD Regulations 2017) requires specification of protected areas for those areas designated as nutrient sensitive areas. Coverage: Natural Resources Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Natural Resources Wales. Its tags are urban waste water treatment. The portal shows 2026-09-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
